beats.text: Why the rich never look rich

beats.title: They buy assets first
beats.sub: Luxury is what assets buy later — not what a salary proves today

beats.title: They refuse visible debt
beats.sub: A $90,000 car on a loan is a $90,000 hole with leather seats

beats.label: of NFL players go broke or feel financial stress within 5 years of retiring

beats.title: They fix boring leaks
beats.sub: Fees, taxes, subscriptions — the quiet drips sink big ships

narration: Why the rich never look rich. Three habits they share.
One. They buy assets first. Luxury is what assets buy later, not what a salary proves today.
Two. They refuse visible debt. A ninety thousand dollar car on a loan is a ninety thousand dollar hole, with leather seats.
Seventy-eight percent of NFL players go broke or feel financial stress within five years of retiring. Income is not wealth.
Three. They fix boring leaks. Fees, taxes, subscriptions — the quiet drips sink big ships.
